text:
Sitting on the swing
the Angelus dozes


The stars and fruits fall silent


And wounded men
walk with their fountains
like lyrical dolphins


Others, more burdened,
with rivers on their shoulders,
pilgrim without knocking at the inns


Life is one endless verse


No one reached its end
No one knows heaven is a garden


Forgetfulness.


The Angelus has died


With bloodied scythe,
a reaper singing walked away.

translation.title: Sitting on the Swing...
